WITH monthly_rev AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_type_code,
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
        SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER) * p.product_price) AS rev
    FROM Order_Items oi
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Customer_Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2000-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2001-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.product_type_code, month
),
annual_tot AS (
    SELECT
        product_type_code,
        SUM(rev) AS total_rev
    FROM monthly_rev
    GROUP BY product_type_code
),
cum AS (
    SELECT
        mr.product_type_code,
        mr.month,
        mr.rev,
        SUM(mr.rev) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.product_type_code ORDER BY mr.month
                          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_rev,
        at.total_rev,
        0.10 * at.total_rev AS threshold
    FROM monthly_rev mr
    JOIN annual_tot at ON mr.product_type_code = at.product_type_code
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        product_type_code,
        month,
        cum_rev,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_type_code ORDER BY month) AS rn
    FROM cum
    WHERE cum_rev > threshold
)
SELECT
    product_type_code,
    month,
    cum_rev
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_type_code;

WITH customer_category_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        p.product_type_code,
        SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL) * p.product_price) AS total_spending
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Completed'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, p.product_type_code
),
qualified_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customer_category_spending
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_type_code) >= 2
),
category_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        product_type_code,
        AVG(total_spending) AS avg_spending
    FROM customer_category_spending
    WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM qualified_customers)
    GROUP BY product_type_code
)
SELECT 
    CCS.customer_name,
    CCS.product_type_code,
    CCS.total_spending,
    (CCS.total_spending / CA.avg_spending) * 100 AS spending_percentage,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CCS.product_type_code ORDER BY CCS.total_spending DESC) AS spending_rank
FROM customer_category_spending CCS
JOIN qualified_customers QC ON CCS.customer_id = QC.customer_id
JOIN category_averages CA ON CCS.product_type_code = CA.product_type_code
ORDER BY CCS.customer_name, CCS.product_type_code
